title: Finite Tor amplitude for closed support
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $T,Z$ be schemes, let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion, and let $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ be its quasi-compact complementary open immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Work in the ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with $Rj_*$ the derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and $Ri^!$ the ambient right adjoint to $i_*$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Let $a,b$ be integers and let $c\geq0$ be an integer. Suppose $R^qj_*M=0$ for every etale $A$-module sheaf $M$ and every $q>c$, and suppose every $R^qj_*$ takes constructible $A$-module sheaves to constructible $A$-module sheaves. If $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ is bounded constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude], then $Ri^!K$ is bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in $[a,b+c+1]$.

proof.text: Apply the constructibility clause of lem-exc-closed-amplitude using the bounded interval already supplied by bounded constructibility of K. Converting the two t-structure bounds into cohomology vanishing and using c >= 0 gives an ordered bounded interval for Q = Ri!K. No ordering of the input Tor interval is needed.

Apply the closed-support finite-constant tensor bound to the finite residue module, then the converse residue test to the bounded constructible exceptional image. A generic implication combines the tensor bound with any applicable finite-module Tor test before specializing the coefficient ring.

proof_origin.place: Proof: tensor the support triangles, then apply exact monoidal closed pullback and its fully faithful counit
